sharedPromptSummary: Original gritty retrofuturistic industrial starship scenery inspired by the visual language of Alien: somber charcoal and olive battered metal, pipes, cable trays, recessed amber CRTs and muted cyan lamps. One square atlas, exactly three equal panoramic rows: near-opaque far room, alpha middle structure with open center, low alpha foreground fittings. No readable text, logo, people, creatures, weapons or game UI.
